svg.title: Particle filtering
svg.desc: Update 9. The density separates prediction and weighting. Below, 160 weighted particles at step 8 supply 160 children, using 17 distinct parents. Parent positions are ranked by state; horizontal spacing in the ancestry diagram is not state distance.
svg.text: Teal: prediction · Navy: filtering · Orange: scaled likelihood
Step 8: parent ranks by state · larger circles have more weight
Step 9: 160 children with equal weights before prediction
Faint parents received no offspring. Links show actual parent indices; spacing shows rank, not state distance.
